name: Kintetsu World Express, Inc.
summary: Kintetsu World Express, Inc., along with its affiliated companies, delivers a comprehensive array of logistics solutions across the globe. Established in 1948 and headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, the company specializes in worldwide air and sea freight forwarding, customs clearance, and extensive logistical support. Its operations span Japan, the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, East Asia, Oceania, and Southeast Asia. The firm's air freight capabilities encompass transportation, local pick-up and delivery, customs processing, bespoke packaging, and specialized installation for precision machinery. For ocean freight, services include forwarding, container drayage, ground transportation, customs procedures, buyer consolidation, and purchase order oversight. Additionally, Kintetsu offers contract logistics, which feature inventory and purchase order management, cross-docking, call center operations, assembly work, quality inspection, and vendor-managed inventory. Further services comprise logistics consulting, multimodal ground transportation (truck, trailer, and rail), specialized transport for vehicles and auto parts, temporary staffing for logistical and trading roles, specialized handling for art and exhibition materials, and expedited hand-carry services. As of July 5, 2022, Kintetsu World Express, Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Kintetsu Group Holdings Co.,Ltd.
